verdict.rationale: Feitian FIDO Keys are hardware authenticators (FIDO2/U2F, PIV, OTP over USB, NFC and BLE). Consuming MCP servers' tools is an AI-agent client role, which is a category error for a hardware security key. Nothing in the evidence shows the product acts as an MCP client or runs any agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
